description.p: Jotta Desktop is a cross-desktop (KDE / GNOME / COSMIC) client for Jottacloud, built in Rust. It provides a GTK4/libadwaita main window for managing backups and sync, plus a StatusNotifierItem tray icon that shows live status and allows pause/resume.
The backend is Jottacloud's official jottad/jotta-cli daemon — the app is a thin frontend that supervises the daemon lifecycle (it reuses a host systemd daemon if one is already running).
Initial iteration: status dashboard, backup list + add folder, sync start/stop, pause/resume, tray icon with 5 states.
